infobox.usage: Unlocks the security room in the parking garage of the Concordia building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Concordia security room key (Conc sec.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the security room inside the Concordia building.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Surveillance

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door in the basement parking garage of the Concordia building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x PC block
- 1x Safe
- Loose loot (Weapons, Weapon mods)
